exitCriteria.title: One account cannot read another account’s saved areas, proven by a test that attempts it directly against the database
exitCriteria.reason: Attested by execution. db/postgres/0001-account-tenant-isolation.sql enables and forces row level security on all three account tables, and scripts/check-postgres-tenant-isolation.mjs opens a second connection as witness_tree_app, a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS role, and attempts cross-tenant reads of saved areas, geometry, alert history and account rows, unfiltered reads, an unset tenant, a blank tenant, cross-tenant update, delete, insert and owner reassignment, disabling row level security, and self-granting BYPASSRLS. All seventeen probes held on 2026-08-26 against PostgreSQL 17 on this repository's merged state, run independently by the integrating engineer as well as by the author. A negative control with row level security removed failed fourteen of the same seventeen, including the victim probe, which then observed account B's own area deleted, account A's reassigned onto B, and a planted row surviving. The probes are therefore falsifiable rather than vacuous. What this attests is exactly what the criterion asks: one account cannot read another account's saved areas, proven by a test that attempts it directly against the database. It attests nothing about Canadian residency, encryption at rest, or a provisioned managed service, and the migration has been applied to no deployed database. Those remain open in the canadian-managed-service-and-direct-rls activation blocker, which stays blocked.

exitCriteria.title: Account deletion removes saved areas and personal data within 30 days, proven by a test
exitCriteria.reason: The deterministic local store policy removes the account, its saved areas, and its alert history at the 30-day deadline; the focused test exercises that boundary. This is local policy evidence only, not proof of a hosted deletion operation.

exitCriteria.title: The kill switch stops all outbound alerts within 5 minutes
exitCriteria.reason: An outbound queue and a sender abstraction now exist in lib/alerts/outbound.ts, and scripts/rehearse-kill-switch.mts measured a stop well under one second from engaging the switch to the last refused send, with alerts still going out after engagement and counted separately. The drill times itself against a recording sender that reaches no recipient, and no independent observer witnessed it, so it is not the rehearsal this criterion requires. A self-timed local drill cannot establish a five-minute operational stop. Independent observation is tracked in the independent-live-rehearsal blocker.

exitCriteria.title: Every alert template carries its evidence class, data version, source agency and observation time
exitCriteria.reason: The local evaluator refuses incomplete event metadata and constructs every bilingual payload with evidence-first-line text, data version, source agency, and observation time. The focused test exercises all seven trigger templates and required fields.

exitCriteria.title: A correction to a published figure produces a correction alert to everyone previously notified
exitCriteria.reason: The local policy selects every history entry for a restated figure and the evaluator permits correction alerts only for a previously notified saved area. Focused tests cover changed-only correction recipients and rejection of an unnotified correction.

activationBlockers.reason: The direct row-level-security isolation test is done and attested by execution against a local PostgreSQL 17 server; it is recorded on the direct-database-tenant-isolation criterion. What remains blocked is the hosting half only: no Canadian managed account database has been provisioned, no encryption-at-rest verification exists, and this migration has been applied to no deployed database.

The plan requires an independent live test of both deletion and the under-five-minute kill switch. A local self-timed drill against a recording sender now exists; an independent observer, a sender that reaches a recipient, and rehearsal evidence from either do not.
Privacy, security, and legal review—including reviewed English/French template and consent wording—remain external approval gates.

localOnlyBoundary: No real personal data is stored and no outbound alert is sent. The default-closed activation guard prevents local policy evidence from activating an account service.
